title: META'S AI
*EDITS YOUR ADS*
slides.sub: Five checks so your ads say what you wrote.

title: SINCE
*30 OCTOBER*
slides.body: Meta's new ad terms make you responsible for every change its AI makes to your ads, even the features Meta switched on for you.

title: OPEN THE
*CREATIVE MENU*
slides.body: In Ads Manager, open each ad and find the Advantage+ creative section. Every AI edit has its own switch. Most start switched on.

title: READ WHAT
*META WROTE*
slides.body: Meta rewrites your ad text. Dave's Osborne Park electrical ad says "licensed". Make sure the rewrite never promises "same day". (Dave's booked till Friday.)

title: LOOK AT
*EVERY PHOTO*
slides.body: Meta crops and stretches your images to fit each spot. A chopped logo looks cheap. Open every preview.

title: SWITCH OFF
*PRODUCT BROWSING*
slides.body: Since 28 October, Meta can show product suggestions inside Facebook before people reach your website. Want people landing on your booking page? Turn product browsing off.

title: RECHECK EVERY
*DUPLICATE*
slides.body: Duplicate an ad or swap the photo and Meta's AI edits can switch back on. Turned them off once, sorted forever? (famous last words)

title: *RECAP*
items: Open each ad's Advantage+ creative menu
Recheck after you duplicate an ad

title: WANT A
*FREE AUDIT?*
slides.body: Send us a DM and I'll check your Facebook and Instagram ads for free.
